When he returned, he stepped onto a piece of OSB and fell approximately 5 feet onto an exposed stair stringer. The employee was hospitalized with two fractured vertebrae in the neck.
event_title: Fall to lower level, unspecified

narrative: An employee was performing excavation activities when he was struck by the counterweight of an excavator, propelling him into the excavation. The employee landed on the boom of another machine, resulting in a fracture to his left hip that required hospitalization.
event_title: Struck by swinging part of powered vehicle

narrative: An employee was handling a spare tire when the tire fell over onto the employee's hand. The employee was hospitalized and suffered a left middle finger amputation.
event_title: Struck by falling object or equipment, unspecified

narrative: On June 15, 2023, at 11:30 AM, an employee was moving a belt on a pumping unit when he slipped, causing his right hand to get caught between the belt and sheave. His right wrist was dislocated and required surgery and his left ring finger was amputated at the last joint. The employee was hospitalized.
event_title: Caught in or compressed by equipment or objects, unspecified

narrative: An employee was delivering mail when they fell from a customer's porch to the ground and sustained a broken hip.
event_title: Other fall to lower level, unspecified

narrative: An employee was cleaning the rollers under a conveyor on a production line using a paper towel. The employee's hand was caught on the roller that supports the belt, amputating their left index fingertip.
event_title: Caught in running equipment or machinery during maintenance, cleaning

narrative: An employee was climbing an A-frame ladder when his left foot slid from the fourth step and he fell to the ground, resulting in a broken tibia. The employee was later hospitalized and required surgery.
event_title: Other fall to lower level, unspecified

narrative: An employee had been working on HVAC duct repair on a roof. The employee was descending a fixed ladder on the side of the building when he slipped on the fifth rung and fell approximately 5 feet to the grass. The employee sustained injury to their scapula and fractures to their clavicle and ribs.
event_title: Other fall to lower level less than 6 feet

narrative: An employee was loading a piece of wood into a mortise and tenon machine. The employee's right ring finger was pinched between the wood and the working surface of the machine, and their fingertip was amputated.
event_title: Caught in running equipment or machinery during regular operation

narrative: An employee was securing a heat exchanger tube sheet, weighing about 150 pounds, for match marking on a vertical stand. The employee's left middle finger was caught between the securement bolt and the table. The employee suffered an amputation to the left middle fingertip.
event_title: Compressed or pinched by shifting objects or equipment

narrative: An employee was cleaning a conveyor belt when the gears on the belt caused a fingertip amputation.
event_title: Caught in running equipment or machinery during maintenance, cleaning

narrative: An employee was operating a planer. As they went to remove a jammed 5x5 piece of lumber, it dislodged and contacted their left middle fingertip, amputating it at the nailbed.
event_title: Struck by dislodged flying object, particle

narrative: An employee was using a portable electric grinder when the grinding disk broke and struck the employee's chin, causing a laceration.
event_title: Struck by dislodged flying object, particle

narrative: An employee was unhooking a sugar cane trailer when their hand was pinched between the safety pin and the trailer's landing gear, resulting in a hand injury.
event_title: Contact with objects and equipment, unspecified

narrative: An employee was working in a cup production area, performing heavy work in a hot area when they began to experience stomach cramps and vision loss. The employee was hospitalized for heat-related illness.
event_title: Exposure to environmental heat

narrative: An employee was disassembling a pipe line when they were exposed to thionyl chloride. The employee sustained chemical burns and was hospitalized.
event_title: Exposure through intact skin, eyes, or other exposed tissue

narrative: An employee was fueling a chop saw in preparation to cut rebar. After placing the saw in a horizontal position, the gas cap leaked fuel onto the employee's leg. The sparks from cutting then ignited the fuel, causing the employee to sustain burns to the left leg and hands.
event_title: Ignition of vapors, gases, or liquids

narrative: An employee was climbing a ladder to apply a belt dressing on a moving head pulley. Their arm became caught in the pulley, resulting in a laceration that required stitches.
event_title: Caught in or compressed by equipment or objects, unspecified

narrative: An employee was unstrapping the banding on a pallet of steel joists at a delivery site when a piece of steel joist fell onto the employee. He sustained a fracture of the spine, broken ribs, and a dislocated left hip.
event_title: Struck by falling object or equipment, unspecified

narrative: An employee was walking backward when they tripped over a pallet jack and fell, hitting their head on the floor and suffering a head injury.
event_title: Fall on same level due to tripping over an object

narrative: An employee was exiting a trailer for it to be loaded when their right ankle was pinned between a piece of angle iron that was anchored to the floor and a long pallet being pushed by a powered industrial truck (PIT). The employee sustained an ankle fracture and was hospitalized.
event_title: Pedestrian struck by forward-moving vehicle in nonroadway area

narrative: An employee was closing the door of a safe when her right thumb was caught between the door of the safe and the safe wall resulting in an amputation to the thumb.
event_title: Compressed or pinched by shifting objects or equipment

narrative: An employee was lifting a 1,600-pound transformer with a pump jack when the pump jack collapsed. The employee suffered a partial amputation to his right middle fingertip.
event_title: Struck by object falling from vehicle or machinery-other than vehicle part

narrative: An employee was working on a label/tube machine when the shrink tubing became stuck while it was exiting the machine. As the employee went to remove the tubing, their fingertip was amputated by the machine blade.
event_title: Caught in running equipment or machinery during maintenance, cleaning

narrative: An employee was lifting a snowblower onto a truck when they sustained a back strain that required hospitalization.
event_title: Overexertion in lifting-single episode

narrative: An employee was oiling a drive chain when their hand was caught in the chain and sprocket, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
event_title: Caught in running equipment or machinery during maintenance, cleaning

narrative: A lift truck operator was unstacking pallets of boxes in the middle portion of a railcar by hand in order to be able to enter the railcar with a forklift and remove the remaining pallets on the left and right sides of the railcar. A pallet on the right side of the railcar had shifted during transportation. A box fell from this pallet onto the employee resulting in possible fractures to their neck and right leg.
event_title: Struck by falling object or equipment, n.e.c.

narrative: An employee was performing maintenance on a roll-up door that had four bolts removed from an L-bracket. Two still-installed bolts sheared off while under pressure, causing the employee's right hand to become caught between the bracket and a chain sprocket. The employee suffered an amputation to their middle finger.
event_title: Compressed or pinched by shifting objects or equipment

narrative: An employee was standing on the side of the road directing traffic. A car was turning left and struck a passing vehicle. The struck vehicle was propelled off the road and into the employee.
event_title: Pedestrian struck by vehicle propelled by another vehicle on side of road

narrative: An employee was standing outside of the vehicle when the door closed on his right ring finger resulting in amputation of the finger.
event_title: Struck by swinging part of powered vehicle
